les.title: 🏋 Drill: kaun aage? Points gino
les.sub: Asli game positions mein material gino, Stockfish se match
yaad: Dono taraf alag jodo, phir farak.

steps.md:
Ab asli games ki positions. Har position mein **dono taraf ke points jodo** aur batao kaun aage hai.

Har jawab **Stockfish** (bahut strong engine) se bhi check kiya gaya hai: jahan engine aur points ek hi baat kehte hain, wahi positions yahan hain.

Engine ka number: **+** matlab White behtar, **−** matlab Black behtar. Jaise **+3** = White lagbhag 3 points aage.

Practice ke baad test: 10 naye sawaal, **80%** par agla lesson.

steps.q: Sirf **points gino** (pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9). Kaun aage hai?
steps.why:
White: 2 rooks (2×5) + 4 pawns (4×1) = **14**

Black: 2 rooks (2×5) + 1 knight (1×3) + 3 pawns (3×1) = **16**

Black **2 points** aage. Stockfish bhi yahi kehta hai: **-4.2** (+ matlab White behtar, − matlab Black).
steps.hint: Dono taraf ke pieces alag alag jodo, phir farak dekho.

steps.q: Black kitne **points** se aage hai?
steps.why:

Black **2 points** aage. Stockfish bhi yahi kehta hai: **-4.2** (+ matlab White behtar, − matlab Black).
steps.hint: White ka total minus Black ka total.

les.title: 🏋 Drill: development aur king safety
les.sub: Material barabar ho to kaun behtar? Opening principles se socho
yaad: Material barabar ho to dekho: kis ke zyada pieces bahar, kis ka king safe.
Center mein reh gaya king = khatra.

steps.h: Drill: opening principles se position padho
steps.md:
Points barabar hon to bhi ek side behtar ho sakti hai. Opening principles yaad karo: **pieces develop karo** aur **jaldi castle karo**.

Har position mein gino: kitne knights/bishops bahar aaye (4 mein se), aur kis ka king castle hua. Jawab Stockfish se check kiya hua hai.

Test: 10 sawaal, **80%**.

steps.q: Material barabar hai. **Opening principles** (development, king safety) se dekho: kaun behtar?
steps.why:
White ke **4** chhote pieces bahar hain, Black ke sirf **1**. Material barabar, par development mein aage.

Stockfish: **+1.6**.
steps.hint: Gino: kis ke knights/bishops bahar aaye? Kis ka king castle hua?

steps.q: White behtar kyun hai?
opts: King castled aur safe hai, dushman ka king center mein
steps.why:
White ke **4** chhote pieces bahar hain, Black ke sirf **1**. Material barabar, par development mein aage.

Stockfish: **+1.6**.

steps.q: Material barabar hai. **Opening principles** (development, king safety) se dekho: kaun behtar?
steps.why:
White ka king castle karke safe hai, Black ka king abhi **center** mein hai. Material barabar, par king safety mein farak.

Stockfish: **+1.3**.
steps.hint: Gino: kis ke knights/bishops bahar aaye? Kis ka king castle hua?

les.title: 🏋 Drill: 5 elements se position samjho
les.sub: Material, time, space, king safety, pawn structure: sabse bada farak kahan?
yaad: Ek element mein aage, doosre mein peeche ho sakte ho.

steps.md:
Har position mein pehle batao **kaun behtar** hai (Stockfish se check), phir **5 elements** mein se sabse bada farak kahan hai.

Jawab ke saath har element ki ginti dikhegi: material, development, space (aadhe board ke paar pawns), king safety (king ke saamne pawns, paas mein dushman pieces), pawn structure (isolated, doubled, passed).

Test: 10 sawaal, **80%**.

steps.q: Kaun behtar hai?
steps.why:
Stockfish: **+1.5** (White behtar).

Sabse bada farak: **Time (development)**. Development: White 3/4, Black 1/4 chhote pieces bahar.

- Material: White 36, Black 36
- Space: White ke 1, Black ke 0 pawns aadhe board ke paar
- King safety: king ke saamne pawns White 1/3, Black 2/3; king ke paas dushman pieces White 0, Black 0
- Pawn structure: isolated/doubled White 0, Black 0; passed pawns White 0, Black 0
steps.hint: 5 elements ek ek karke dekho.

- King safety: king ke saamne pawns White 1/3, Black 2/3; king ke paas dushman pieces White 0, Black 0
- Pawn structure: isolated/doubled White 0, Black 0; passed pawns White 0, Black 0

- King safety: king ke saamne pawns White 0/3, Black 0/3; king ke paas dushman pieces White 0, Black 0

les.title: 🏋 Drill: engine jaisa number socho
les.sub: Position dekh kar eval ki range batao: GM ki aadat
yaad: +1 ≈ ek pawn ka fayda, +3 ≈ ek piece: aksar jeet.
Saare elements milakar socho, sirf material nahi.

steps.md:
Strong players position dekh kar andaaza lagate hain ki fayda **kitna** hai. Engine yeh number pawns mein deta hai:

- **0 ke paas**: barabar
- **+1**: White ko lagbhag ek pawn jitna fayda
- **+3 ya zyada**: White aksar jeet raha (ek piece jitna)
- **−** wale number Black ke liye.

Saare elements milakar socho, phir range chuno. Test: 10 sawaal, **80%**.

les.title: 🏋 Drill: mushkil evals aur compensation (GM)
les.sub: Range ke kinare wale aur material ke ulat positions
yaad: Material sab kuch nahi: compensation dekho.
Pehle khud socho, phir engine (analysis ka rule).

steps.md:
Ab mushkil positions: kai mein ek side **material mein peeche** hai par phir bhi behtar (compensation), aur kai range ke kinare par hain. Elements ek ek karke gino, phir number socho.
